assets.name: Stone altar
assets.description: A village temple's altar of pale dressed grey stone on a slightly wider plinth step, with a carved band under its overhanging top slab, a dull red altar cloth over the top hanging down the front, and three short ivory candles in iron dishes. It stands behind its origin, so it can go against a wall.

assets.name: Crude stone altar
assets.description: A crude altar of rough unhewn dark stone, about 1.5 m long, 0.9 m deep and 1 m high: two rough uprights packed with smaller stones under a thick lumpy capstone, its top and front streaked with old dark stains that ran down the faces and dried in a pool at its foot.

assets.name: Iron anvil
assets.description: A blacksmith's dark iron anvil about 0.75 m long, with a tapered horn, a flat steel face and a square heel, standing on a sawn wooden log block about 0.5 m high bound with an iron band.

assets.name: Armour stand
assets.description: A wooden armour stand about 0.65 × 0.5 × 1.8 m: a cross-footed base and a post with a shoulder yoke carrying a knee-length mail shirt with short sleeves and a belted waist, a round iron helm with a nasal on top.

assets.name: Cult banner
assets.description: A tattered dark wine-red cloth banner on a tall iron pole, about 1 m wide and 2.5 m high: it hangs from an iron crossbar under a spiked finial, its lower edge torn into ragged tails, a pale sigil of a ring round a five-pointed star painted on its front, and the pole stands in a heavy cross-shaped iron foot.

assets.name: Wooden barrel
assets.description: A short wooden barrel about 0.6 m wide and 0.9 m high, its curved staves of slightly varied wood held by three dark iron hoops and closed with a plank lid.

assets.name: Wooden bed
assets.description: A simple village bed, about 2.0 m long and 1.0 m wide: a low wooden frame on four short square legs with a 0.9 m plank headboard and a lower footboard, a straw mattress under an off-white linen sheet, a pillow at the head and a blue-grey wool blanket folded back over the lower half.

assets.name: Bedroll with pack
assets.description: A worn bedroll laid out on the floor, about 2 m long and 0.8 m wide: a padded canvas mat with a patch, a rolled grey-green cloak tied as a pillow at the head, a rumpled dull red striped wool blanket thrown over the rest with its top folded back, and a leather pack with a buckled flap and a bundle on top standing beside the head.

assets.name: Straw beehive skep
assets.description: A traditional beehive skep about 0.5 m wide and 0.55 m high: a dome of coiled golden straw rope with a small dark entrance at the base, sitting on a round wooden board on a short stake stand.

assets.name: Wooden bench
assets.description: A simple backless village bench, about 1.4 m long, 0.35 m deep and 0.45 m high: one thick plank seat on two splayed trestle legs joined by a pegged stretcher.

assets.name: Birch tree
assets.description: A slender white birch about 6 m high: a thin, gently curving chalk-white trunk with black horizontal bark marks and a dark fissured foot, thin ascending branches arching out at the tips, and a narrow airy crown of small yellow-green leaf clumps, some hanging from the branch tips.

assets.name: Pile of bones
assets.description: A loose heap of old yellowed human bones about 0.9 m across and 0.4 m high: several skulls, long bones, ribs and a jaw piled on the floor, with a few bones scattered around it.

assets.name: Shore boulders
assets.description: A cluster of three large weathered shore boulders, the biggest about 1.2 m high, of rounded grey-brown stone with darker bases, with a few small pebbles scattered around them.

assets.name: Low bramble patch
assets.description: A low patch of brambles about 1 × 1 m and 0.6 m high: a mound of dark bramble leaves over a dark tangle, purple-red thorny canes arching out over the rim and rooting their tips in the ground, a dead grey cane or two, ripe and unripe blackberries and a few pale blossoms.

assets.name: Iron brazier
assets.description: A standing wrought-iron brazier about 1 m high: a wide fire bowl with a rolled rim on three splayed legs tied by a ring brace, heaped with black coals glowing orange at the heart under low flames.

assets.name: Wooden bucket
assets.description: A small wooden water bucket about 0.35 m high and 0.3 m across, its tapered staves held by two dark iron hoops, with an iron bail handle and dark water inside. The tipped variant lies empty on its side.

assets.name: Flowering bush
assets.description: A round shrub about 0.8 m across and 0.65 m high: a dense dome of pointed leaf cards round a dark core, deep green inside and underneath, olive at the sides and lit yellow-green on the top and outer rims, dotted with a few dozen small five-petal blossoms on the lit top. Variants have warm cream or soft yellow blossoms.

assets.name: Round bush
assets.description: A round leafy shrub, wider than tall: a dense dome of clumped leaf cards on a few short woody stems hidden at the base, deep shadow green inside and underneath, olive in between and lit yellow-green on the top and outer rims. Variants are a medium bush, a small bush and a large, slightly lopsided bush of three merged lobes.

assets.name: Camp fire in a stone ring
assets.description: A camp fire about 1.2 m across: a ring of rough grey-brown stones, some blackened, round a bed of grey ash and glowing embers, two logs laid in a cross with three sticks leant together over them and low flames at the heart.

assets.name: Wrought-iron candle stand
assets.description: A tall wrought-iron candle stand on a three-legged splayed foot, with a thin slightly twisted iron stem about 1.4 m high and a round drip pan at the top holding one thick ivory wax candle. Dark iron with worn highlights.

assets.name: Melted church candles
assets.description: A cluster of seven pale wax church candles of different heights, from 0.08 to 0.3 m, standing on the floor in a shared puddle of hardened wax about 0.4 m across. Wax drips run down their sides and small dark wicks sit in their melted tops.

assets.name: Handcart
assets.description: A two-wheeled wooden handcart parked on its stand, loaded with two grain sacks.

assets.name: Wooden chair
assets.description: A rustic inn chair with its seat at 0.45 m and back at 0.95 m: a three-board plank seat on four square legs with stretchers, the back legs rising into a ladder back of two slats under a heavy top rail.

assets.name: Iron-bound chest
assets.description: A heavy closed chest of dark stained planks, about 1 m wide, 0.7 m deep and 0.7 m high, with a low domed lid, wrapped in iron: an iron-shod plinth, hoops round the body, corner plates, studded straps over the lid, side ring handles and a round rusty lock plate on the front bearing a raised sigil, a ring round a five-pointed star, under a hasp.

assets.name: Wooden chest
assets.description: A low oak plank chest, 0.9 m wide, 0.55 m deep and 0.6 m high, with a slightly domed lid, dark iron corner bands and straps, side ring handles and an iron hasp with a padlock on the front.

assets.name: Chopping block
assets.description: A thick round chopping block cut from a tree trunk, about 0.5 m across and 0.45 m high, with a pale ringed top and dark bark. A wood axe with a dark iron head and an ash haft is stuck into its top at an angle, and a few split logs and chips lie around it.

assets.name: Rock cliff outside corner
assets.description: The outside corner of the mossy grey cliff, a 1.5 × 1.5 m block about 3.5 m high: the rock face runs along -y, turns round a broken, rounded corner and runs on along +x, leaning back as it rises, with ledges, small overhangs and dark cracks, moss on the ledges, damp at the foot, a grassy top and ivy hanging over the edge. It joins a straight cliff section on -x and a straight section turned to face +x on +y.

assets.name: Rock cliff section
assets.description: A straight 1.5 m section of mossy grey cliff about 3.5 m high and 1.5 m deep: a rock face on -y that leans back as it rises, broken into ledges and small overhangs by layered strata and split by dark vertical cracks, with moss on the ledges, damp at the foot, a grassy top and ivy hanging over the edge. Sections set side by side join into one continuous cliff.

assets.name: Corner cobweb
assets.description: A dusty grey orb web about 1 m across strung on a diagonal across a corner between two short stubs of dark crypt ashlar, about 1 m high, that meet in an L at the back: radial threads to the stubs and the floor, a loose spiral, a sagging top thread, a few broken drooping strands and clots of dust.

assets.name: Wooden coffin
assets.description: A plain six-sided wooden coffin about 2 m long, 0.6 m wide at the shoulders and 0.45 m high, of dark weathered planks with iron nails and two iron handles on each long side, its lid slid a little askew.

assets.name: Wooden shop counter
assets.description: A village shop's closed wooden sales counter, about 2.6 m long, 0.7 m deep and nearly 1 m high: vertical front planks over a darker plinth board, a thick overhanging oak top, and a small iron balance scale and a little stack of coins on it.

assets.name: Small wooden crates
assets.description: Two small wooden crates stacked, the top one smaller and slightly turned, each with plank sides, darker corner battens and a lid, about 0.35 m and 0.28 m cubes, total height about 0.6 m. Variant `crate_small_open`: one open small crate (no lid) full of round dull red and green apples.

assets.name: Wooden crate
assets.description: A plain wooden shipping crate, about 0.75 m on each side, made of slightly uneven nailed planks with darker corner battens and a plank lid.

assets.name: Barrow crypt entrance
assets.description: A grassy hillside barrow mouth about 3 × 3 m and 2.5 m high: a turf mound with a passage cut into its front, lined with dry-stone walls, framed by two weathered standing stones under a heavy lintel, with worn stone steps that thin and darken as they go down into the black mouth. Two more old standing stones lean at the foot of the mound.

assets.name: Iron crypt gate
assets.description: A crypt gate 1.6 m wide and about 2.4 m high: a round-arched doorway of grey dressed stone with a raised keystone, closed by an iron grille door of vertical bars and two cross bands whose spear-point tips rise under the arch, hung on heavy strap hinges and locked with a large padlock on a hasp.

assets.name: Iron-bound door
assets.description: A heavy closed door of dark oak planks, 1.0 m wide and 2.0 m high, crossed by three studded iron bands that end in strap hinges on the left, with a ring pull and a rusty lock plate on the front, set in a frame of cool dark dressed stone with a deep lintel and a worn threshold, 1.5 m wide, 0.3 m deep and 2.4 m high.

assets.name: Wooden plank door
assets.description: A sturdy closed village door, 1.0 m wide, 2.0 m high and 0.08 m thick, of vertical oak planks held by two horizontal ledges and a diagonal brace on the back, with two black iron strap hinges and a ring handle on the front. It fits the opening of wall_stone_doorframe.

assets.name: Farm tools on a trestle
assets.description: A pitchfork and a wooden rake, heads on the ground, leaning together against a short X-legged wooden trestle with a cross bar; the hafts are weathered ash about 1.6 m tall, the fork has dark iron tines and the rake a pegged wooden head.

assets.name: Wooden rail fence
assets.description: A rustic fence section of weathered grey-brown wood: two round split posts near the ends and two slightly sagging split rails running the full 1.5 m, so sections join end to end.

assets.name: Fern clump
assets.description: A clump of woodland ferns: long arching fronds rise from one dark crown and bend outwards, each a tapering midrib with alternating leaflets that shrink towards the tip, deep green inside and underneath and yellow-green on the outer, upper fronds. Variants are an upright clump and a lower, flatter, spreading one.

assets.name: Stone fireplace
assets.description: An inn's open hearth of rough grey-brown fieldstone, about 2.6 m wide, 0.9 m deep and 1.4 m high, built against a wall, with a dark arched fire opening under a heavy timber mantel beam, a low stone hearth slab in front, and burning logs on glowing embers inside under an iron pot hanging from a hook.

assets.name: Firewood stack
assets.description: A neat stack of split firewood logs for a village house wall, about 1.2 m long, 0.8 m high and 0.5 m deep: pale warm split faces and end grain, dark brown bark, the logs a little irregular in length and angle, resting on two short squared sleeper beams off the ground.

assets.name: Clay flower pot
assets.description: A terracotta pot of soil with green leaves and red and yellow flowers.

assets.name: Stone fountain
assets.description: An octagonal dressed-stone basin about 2.6 m across with a 0.6 m rim around still water, and a central stone pillar carrying a smaller upper bowl at about 1.6 m. Weathered grey-brown stone with a little moss at the base.

assets.name: Wooden field gate
assets.description: A 1.5 m plank field gate in weathered grey-brown wood: four rails, two stiles and a diagonal brace, hung on iron strap hinges between two round posts and closed with an iron latch, matching the rail fence.

assets.name: Goblin camp lean-to
assets.description: A crude lean-to about 2 × 2 m and 1.5 m high, open at the front: crooked branch rafters lean from a ridge pole on two forked posts to the ground, covered with ragged overlapping hides, more spread on the ground behind under stones,, over a bed of trodden straw with a matted fur, gnawed bones, a horned skull on a stick and a flint-tipped spear.

assets.name: Grass tuft
assets.description: A small clump of wild grass: thin tapering blades fanning out from one root, olive green with dry yellow tips. Variants are a short tuft, a taller tuft with seed-head stalks, and a dry straw-coloured half-dead tuft.

assets.name: Hay bale
assets.description: A rectangular straw hay bale bound with two twine bands, about 0.9 m long, 0.5 m wide and 0.45 m high, golden but slightly desaturated, with loose wisps sticking out of its edges and a few strands on the ground around it. A variant stacks two bales side by side with a third across them on top, about 0.9 m high.

assets.name: Haystack
assets.description: A rounded farm haystack about 1.4 m across and 1.7 m high: a lumpy dome of golden-brown straw with loose wisps at the base and a few darker weathered patches on top.

assets.name: Herb pots
assets.description: A small cluster of three weathered, desaturated terracotta pots of different sizes, the largest about 0.3 m high, with bushy green herbs: basil-like leaves, a fine thyme-like shrub and one with a few small pale lilac flowers.

assets.name: Ivy creeper
assets.description: A low strip of overlapping pointed ivy leaves on thin woody vines along the foot of a wall: flat and tall at the back where it hugs the wall, with a few runners climbing higher, spilling forward and down to the ground in front, uneven along its length and tapering off at both ends. Dark green inside, olive, and lit yellow-green on the top and rims; variants are a 1.5 m and a 0.8 m strip.

assets.name: Keg rack
assets.description: Two oak kegs lying side by side on a heavy timber cradle, about 1.45 × 0.6 × 1 m: each keg of curved staves held by four iron hoops, a wooden spigot in its front head; the cradle of sills, posts and top rails with angled chocks under the kegs.

assets.name: Street lamp post
assets.description: A tall dark timber post about 2.6 m high on a small stone foot, with an iron bracket arm at the top from which hangs a small four-sided iron lantern with warm glass panes.

assets.name: Fallen leaves
assets.description: A few fallen leaves lying flat on the ground, slightly curled at the edges and tips, in brown, ochre and dull red, each about 8 cm long. Variants are five or six scattered leaves and a small drift of a dozen.

assets.name: Wooden lectern
assets.description: A carved dark oak lectern about 1.25 m high: a cross-shaped scrolled foot, a fluted square post with carved collars and a sloping desk with rosette side panels and a ledge, holding a heavy open book with a red ribbon.

assets.name: Fallen log
assets.description: A fallen tree trunk about 3 m long lying on the forest floor, with ridged dark bark, broken branch stubs, moss cushions along its top, a weathered cut end showing growth rings and a splintered break at the thin end.

assets.name: Market stall
assets.description: A village market stall about 2.8 m long and 1.3 m deep: a wooden plank counter 0.9 m high on the front, four corner posts and a striped muted red and cream cloth awning sloping down toward the front, top at about 2.3 m. Small crates, baskets and round produce sit on the counter.

assets.name: Moss patch
assets.description: A flat, low lumpy cushion of moss with a soft irregular outline, small rounded bumps and a few tiny tufts, flat underneath so it sits on stones, wall caps and the foot of walls. Mid moss green with deep green hollows and yellow-green lit bumps and rims; variants are a patch and a long thin strip for a wall cap.

assets.name: Mushroom cluster
assets.description: A cluster of woodland toadstools about 0.3 m across growing from a low mound of dark soil and leaf litter: a few taller ones with domed brown caps and smaller pale ones with flatter caps, their stems leaning slightly apart.

assets.name: Fallen net trap
assets.description: A heavy square hemp net about 2 × 2 m with a thicker border rope, lying where it fell in a heap: its middle bunched up over folded net with the coiled drop line on top, its edges sagging out flat to a rope-lashed stone weight at each corner.

assets.name: Village notice board
assets.description: A plank board framed between two square timber posts under a small pitched shingle roof, about 2.2 m high, with parchment notices and a faded red bill pinned to its front.

assets.name: Oak tree
assets.description: A broad old oak tree about 7 m high and 6 m across: a thick gnarled trunk with deep furrowed bark splitting into a few heavy crooked limbs, under a wide rounded crown of clumped dark-green leaf masses with gaps between them.

assets.name: Pebbles
assets.description: A few loose grey-brown pebbles and one fist-sized stone lying half sunk in the ground, with a little moss. Variants are a small scatter of six pebbles and a larger cluster around one flat stone.

assets.name: Wooden jetty
assets.description: A short wooden jetty section about 4 m long and 1.6 m wide: weathered planks with uneven gaps laid across two stringers on crossbeams, held up by four pairs of round timber posts standing on the ground, with a taller mooring post wrapped in rope at one end.

assets.name: Stone pillar
assets.description: A square crypt pillar of dark blue-grey dressed stone, 0.7 m square and 3 m high: a stepped moulded base, a shaft of five stacked drums with worn dark joints, and a chamfered capital under a broad square abacus, damp-stained at the foot.

assets.name: Broken stone pillar
assets.description: The snapped stump of a square crypt pillar in dark blue-grey dressed stone: its stepped base and two drums, broken off in a ragged pale break about 1.4 m up, with the fallen drum lying on its side beside it and chips and grit around. The stump stands on the origin, where the whole pillar would.

assets.name: Pine tree
assets.description: A tall pine tree about 6 m high: a straight brown trunk with rough bark and a few roots spreading at the foot, under five stacked tiers of drooping dark-green needle boughs that narrow to a pointed top, each tier slightly irregular and turned.

assets.name: Open spiked pit
assets.description: A 1.5 m square of dark crypt floor flags, its rim at floor level, round a square pit about 1 m across whose edges are broken away into jagged chunks; stepped dark ledges lead the eye down to a near-black floor bristling with rows of rusty iron spikes and a little fallen rubble.

assets.name: Potion shelf
assets.description: An apothecary's narrow wooden wall shelf about 1.05 × 0.35 × 1.5 m, open at the front: four lipped shelves crowded with stoppered glass bottles and flasks in dull greens, ambers and reds, cloth-covered clay jars and small lidded pots.

assets.name: Stone pressure plate
assets.description: A 1.5 m square of dark crypt floor flags a few centimetres high whose middle is one big worn flagstone standing slightly proud of the rest, with a dark open gap all round it and grit lodged in the gap.

assets.name: Water puddle
assets.description: A shallow puddle of dark, faintly green standing water about 1 m across and a few centimetres high: an irregular glossy pool of merged lobes inside a rim of wet darkened silt, with a few stones and grit at its margin.

assets.name: Reed clump
assets.description: A clump of reeds and rushes for the rim of a pool, about 0.6 m across and 1.2 m high: long flat olive blades bending outwards from a dark wet mud base, some with dry tan tips, thin round rushes between them and a few brown bulrush heads on tall stalks.

assets.name: Ritual circle
assets.description: A round patch of dark crypt flagstones about 3.5 m across and a few centimetres high, ringed by curved kerb stones, with a dark red-brown sigil painted over it: two concentric rings with rune marks between them, a five-pointed star with a small ring at each point, and a dark disc at the centre.

assets.name: Rock mass block
assets.description: A block of solid, rough cool-grey bedrock filling a 1.5 × 1.5 m footprint about 3 m high: split, faceted faces with ledges of tilted strata, dark and pale patches, damp staining at the foot and a broken, uneven top. It repeats seamlessly side by side on a 1.5 m grid to fill the solid rock between crypt corridors.

assets.name: Mossy boulder
assets.description: A rounded, weathered cool-grey boulder with thick clumped moss cushions in three greens on its upward-facing top and ledges, a little moss creeping down the shoulders and bare stone on the sides and base. Variants are a boulder with a smaller stone leaning against it, a small single stone and a large heap of three stacked, merged boulders.

assets.name: Wooden rowboat
assets.description: A small wooden rowboat about 3.2 m long and 1.2 m wide resting upright on the ground, built of overlapping clinker planks with a pointed bow and a flat transom. Two thwart seats cross it and a pair of oars lies inside.

assets.name: Stone rubble
assets.description: A heap of fallen dressed masonry about 1.2 m across and 0.6 m high: dark blue-grey ashlar blocks and a coping slab tumbled and stacked on a low mound of grit, some broken with paler fresh faces, with chips and grit spilled round the foot.

assets.name: Woven rug
assets.description: A flat woven rug about 2 × 1.5 m in faded madder red, indigo and ochre wool: a striped border round a field of small diamonds with a large stepped medallion at its centre, and knotted fringe on both short ends.

assets.name: Grain sacks
assets.description: A heap of three plump burlap grain sacks, two lying side by side and one propped on top, each tied at the neck with twine; the coarse cloth is a warm desaturated tan with a darker patch or two, slightly slumped and lumpy, about 0.7 m high. A variant is a single upright sack about 0.6 m high.

assets.name: Young sapling
assets.description: A young broadleaf sapling about 2 m high: a thin, slightly crooked grey-brown stem with a small root flare, a few slender branches rising from it, and a loose open crown of fresh green pointed leaves in small clusters.

assets.name: Stone sarcophagus
assets.description: A heavy chest of worn grey stone, about 2.2 m long, 0.9 m wide and 1 m high, on a moulded plinth with a moulded rim and carved panels, its lid carved with the low relief of a lying knight with folded hands on his sword; cracked corners and a little moss in the joints.

assets.name: Merchant's wooden shelf
assets.description: A merchant's wooden shelf unit, open at the front, standing flush against a wall: about 1.35 m wide, 0.45 m deep and 1.5 m high, with two plank sides, a back of vertical boards and three shelves plus the top holding clay jars, a folded bolt of dull cloth, small wooden boxes and a coil of rope.

assets.name: Hanging inn sign
assets.description: A square timber post about 2.2 m high on a small stone footing, with a short arm at the top from which a painted plank hangs on two short chains, its dark face showing a faded ochre tankard.

assets.name: Wooden signpost
assets.description: A square weathered oak post about 2.3 m high set in a low ring of stones, with two pointed plank arrow boards near the top pointing in opposite directions at slightly different heights and a small iron cap.

assets.name: Stone stairs
assets.description: A flight of worn stone steps, 1.5 m wide and 3 m long, between two dark blue-grey ashlar crypt walls 3 m high, with a raking string course along both walls and heavy lintels roofing the far end. Going down, the treads sink step by step under an ever lower ceiling into darkness; going up, the steps rise under a lintel to a dark opening.

assets.name: Stone statue
assets.description: A weathered stone statue of a robed, hooded figure about 1.9 m tall, hands folded on the pommel of a point-down sword, on a square dressed-stone plinth 0.9 m wide and 0.5 m high with a moulded top edge. Worn grey-brown stone, simple robe folds, no face detail, a little moss at the plinth base.

assets.name: Wooden stool
assets.description: A three-legged inn stool with its seat top at 0.45 m: a thick round seat about 0.36 m across on three splayed, tapered legs braced by a ring of round stretchers.

assets.name: Straw scatter
assets.description: Loose straw strewn on the ground: a thin flat drift of pale golden stalks crossing each other, at most a few centimetres high. Variants are a thin drift and a small trampled heap.

assets.name: Wooden trestle table
assets.description: A sturdy inn table, about 1.35 m long, 0.8 m wide, top at 0.75 m: thick oak planks with slight gaps between them on four square legs with stretchers, a single pewter mug standing on it.

assets.name: Pewter tankards on a tray
assets.description: A small rimmed wooden tray, about 0.48 × 0.32 m, holding three pewter tankards (one with a hinged lid, two full of foaming ale) and a bellied pewter jug with a spout and a loop handle.

assets.name: Tapestry on a stand
assets.description: A woven wall hanging about 1.05 × 0.3 × 2 m: a faded wool tapestry with a patterned border, a stylised tree and two birds, hanging by loops from a wooden rod with turned finials on a two-post stand with fringe along its foot.

assets.name: Bramble thicket
assets.description: A dense, impassable mass of brambles and undergrowth about 1.5 × 1.5 m and 1.6 m high: dark bramble leaves over a near-black tangle, purple-red thorny canes arching out and drooping back, a few dead grey canes, clusters of ripe and unripe blackberries and a scatter of pale blossoms. Its ends match and its lumps repeat every 1.5 m, so thickets set side by side along x read as one continuous hedge.

assets.name: Wall torch in an iron sconce
assets.description: A wrought-iron wall bracket, a riveted plate with two scrolls, holding a pitch torch that leans out from the wall: a wooden haft, a dark pitch-soaked rag head bound with cord, glowing at the top under a short flame.

assets.name: Stone watchtower
assets.description: A round stone watchtower about 12 m high: three stepped drystone drums with dark string courses, a crenellated parapet, a red conical roof with an iron finial, warm-lit slit windows and a plank door on the ground floor.

assets.name: Treasure pile
assets.description: A heap of gold coins about 1.2 m across and 0.5 m high, strewn with loose coins, with a jewelled goblet half buried near the top, a crown tipped on its side on the front slope, a few cut rubies, sapphires and emeralds, and coins spilt round its foot.

assets.name: Dead tree
assets.description: A bare dead snag about 5 m high: a leaning grey trunk stripped of most of its bark, with flared roots and the last dark bark at its foot, long cracks in the silvered wood, a jagged splintered top, two crooked bare limbs with forked twigs, snapped limb stubs, woodpecker holes and a few shelf fungi.

assets.name: Tree stump
assets.description: An old cut tree stump about 0.7 m across and 0.5 m high, with a flat weathered cut face showing growth rings, an axe notch chopped into its side, rough ridged bark, and thick roots spreading into the ground.

assets.name: Funeral urn
assets.description: A round-bellied clay urn about 0.45 m high with a narrow neck, a fitted knobbed lid, two small loop handles and a band of incised zigzags, chipped at the rim, standing on a square stone block.

assets.name: Crypt wall corner
assets.description: An L-shaped corner of crypt wall, 0.6 m thick and 3 m high, in the cool, dark dressed ashlar of the crypt wall section: long quoins alternate between the arms over a square corner pier, worn rounded arrises over dark recessed joints, a slightly proud footing course and a plain coping. One arm runs 0.75 m from the corner to +x, the other to +y, where they meet straight sections. Damp darkens the footing and streaks the outer faces.

assets.name: Crypt wall with arched doorway
assets.description: A 1.5 m section of crypt wall, 0.6 m thick and 3 m high, with an empty round-arched doorway about 1.1 m wide and 2.2 m high, in the cool, dark dressed ashlar of the crypt wall section: jamb blocks up to the springing line, a ring of wedge voussoirs with a paler keystone standing a little proud, coursed blocks cut to the arch above it, worn rounded arrises over dark recessed joints and a plain coping. Damp darkens the jamb footings and streaks the faces.

assets.name: Crypt wall with burial niches
assets.description: A 1.5 m section of the dark blue-grey ashlar crypt wall, 0.6 m thick and 3 m high, with two burial niches stacked in its front face under long lintel stones. The lower niche holds a body wrapped in a pale, stained linen shroud tied with cords; the upper one holds only a skull, two bones and grave dust.

assets.name: Crypt wall section
assets.description: A straight 1.5 m section of crypt wall, 0.6 m thick and 3 m high: cool, dark blue-grey dressed ashlar in regular staggered courses with worn rounded arrises over dark recessed joints, a slightly proud footing course and a plain coping on top. Damp darkens most of the footing blocks and runs down the faces in a few streaks under the joints.

assets.name: Fieldstone wall corner
assets.description: An L-shaped corner of village fieldstone wall, 0.45 m thick and 2.4 m high: rough grey-brown stone blocks in staggered courses over recessed mortar, tied by alternating quoins at a square corner pier, with flat capstones on top. One arm runs 0.75 m from the corner to +x, the other to +y, where they meet 1.5 m straight wall sections. The `_low` variant is a cutaway wall (about 1.4 m) for roofless village buildings, so what is inside stays visible. The `_rubble` variants (`_rubble`, `_rubble_2`, each also `_low`) are the same corner in rubble: rounded stones of mixed sizes, a long corner stone per course tying the arms, dark recessed joints, rounded cap stones; `_moss` adds moss on the caps and at the foot.

assets.name: Stone wall with doorway
assets.description: A section of village fieldstone wall, 1.5 m long, 0.45 m thick and 2.4 m high, with an empty door opening 1.0 m wide and 2.0 m high in the middle, framed by lighter dressed stone quoins on both jambs and a single heavy stone lintel, under a row of flat capstones. A wooden door (door_wood) is placed into the opening separately. The `_low` variant is a cutaway doorway: two quoined piers as high as the low walls, with no lintel. The `_rubble` variants (`_rubble`, `_rubble_2`, each also `_low`) are the doorway in rubble: a rounded jamb stone per course cut flat on the opening, one long rough lintel, rounded cap stones; the opening stays 1.0 x 2.0 m. `_moss` adds moss on the caps and at the foot of the piers.

assets.name: Half-timbered wall corner

assets.name: Half-timbered wall
assets.description: A straight section of half-timbered village house wall on a low fieldstone plinth: a dark weathered oak sill, corner posts, a top plate and one diagonal brace framing warm off-white lime plaster. assets.name: Wooden wardrobe
assets.description: A tall plank wardrobe about 1.2 × 0.6 × 2 m: a framed carcass on a plinth with a moulded cornice, two doors of vertical boards on its front with iron strap hinges, ring pulls and a hasp.

assets.name: Washing line
assets.description: A sagging rope strung about 1.8 m up between two leaning round posts with short cross arms, with laundry pegged along it: a linen sheet, a faded blue shirt, brown hose, an apron and a red rag.

assets.name: Rock waterfall
assets.description: A small waterfall about 3 m high: a stream runs between stacked grey rocks, spills over a jutting mossy lip stone and falls as a pale sheet with foam streaks into a dark pool ringed by rim stones, moss on every ledge.

assets.name: Weapon rack
assets.description: A merchant's timber weapon rack, about 1.2 × 0.4 × 1.5 m: two footed, braced uprights joined by a bottom board and two pairs of slotted rails, holding three iron-headed spears, a sword hung by its crossguard and a bearded axe.

assets.name: Stone well
assets.description: A round drystone well with a plank roof on two posts, a winch with a crank and a bucket on a rope.

assets.name: Wooden wheelbarrow
assets.description: An old wooden wheelbarrow, about 1.4 m long and 0.6 m wide, with a plank tray with sloped sides about 0.6 m high, one spoked wooden wheel with an iron tyre at the front and two long handles to the back resting on two short legs. It holds a few logs or some earth.

assets.name: Wildflowers
assets.description: A small patch of wildflowers among a few olive grass blades: thin stems about 0.2 m high topped with tiny flat blossoms. One variant has white and yellow blossoms, the other pale violet and white.
